_about: Labelled synthetic job listings for M3 field extraction (written for JobPilot; no real postings). 'tuning' cases were written during the M3 audit and guided the parser. 'heldout-a' cases were written after the parser and first measured untuned: employment type P 91%/R 100%, mandatory experience P 100%/R 81%, work arrangement P 100%/R 72%, remote region P 100%/R 83%, mandatory skills P 100%/R 100%, preferred skills P 100%/R 93%. 'heldout-b' was written after the heldout-a fixes and first measured untuned: employment P 100%/R 100%, experience P 100%/R 75%, work arrangement P 89%/R 100%, region P 67%/R 100%, mandatory and preferred skills 100%/100%. Misses were then fixed (generally, not per case) and every case kept as a regression case. known_misses lists the fields where the parser still disagrees with the label. Freshers / no experience required = [0, null]. Fixed-term = contract. Soft skills are never mandatory. These numbers describe this small synthetic set only, not real-world accuracy. Owner decision (2026-11-27): a location such as "London or Remote (UK)" is remote with region United Kingdom; heldout-b-10 was relabelled accordingly.
